question:
What is the mean of the following distribution?

 
 

 Marks
 12 
 22 
 58 
 79 
 89 
 
 
 
 

 No. of Students
 98
 74
 17
 28
 44
solution:
**Given:**

Marks = [12, 22, 58, 79, 89]

No. of Students = [98, 74, 17, 28, 44]

**Formula used:**

Mean = dfrac{{Sum of (Marks × No. of Students)}}{{Sum of No. of Students}}
